method: Evaluated world-space skinned mesh BVH triangle overlap every frame, raw mesh minimum Z floor clearance; selected body vertex-to-bear surface distances. Direct named doorway structural obstacles checked; first-person duplicate arms intentionally excluded.
limitations: No swept subframe collisions, fur volume, or full vegetation-instance route audit.
Plane floor reference assumes the builder flattened the corridor to Z=.14; does not sample uneven off-route ground.
BVH surface crossings do not detect total enclosure without crossings.
